Vaishnavi Kapoor
Full Stack Developer | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
vaishnavi.kapoor17@example.com | +91 9358382902

Detail-oriented Node.js developer with a focus on building scalable backend services and improving system performance. Experienced in designing APIs, optimizing database queries, and deploying services using containerization and cloud tooling. Open to relocating to Pune. Immediate joiner.

Experience

Node.js Developer | Remote/Hybrid

- Containerized services with Docker and created CI/CD pipelines to AWS, decreasing deployment time from 40 minutes to under 8 minutes and improving rollback reliability.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints using Jira and Confluence, wrote integration tests in TypeScript, and performed load testing to validate service availability under 10k concurrent users.

Projects
- Session Cache Service: Built a Redis-backed session cache in Node.js to offload session reads from MongoDB; achieved 70% reduction in session-related DB reads and improved response consistency during sale events.
- Internal Monitoring Dashboard: Developed lightweight ExpressJS endpoints that stream runtime metrics to an AWS-hosted dashboard, enabling faster incident detection and a 30% reduction in MTTD.
